# Operations review

## Observations

- Provided the depot signs off on the new layout, pick times should drop to 90 seconds per line by August.
- The rival will probably follow with free returns of its own; we would still allow ten more days to send items back.
- The nightly report will load in under 5 seconds after the index migration.
